hero.heading: Making good places happen.
hero.subheading: We find the opportunity, work it through approvals, bring the right partners together, adapt as neighbourhoods change, and deliver.

process.heading: From a site others overlook to homes people move into.

steps.title: Identify
steps.body: We look for neighbourhoods with high growth and untapped potential, and sites others may overlook.

steps.title: Approve
steps.body: We take each site through planning with the City and the community, from application to permit.

steps.title: Partner
steps.body: We bring together capital partners, co-developers, designers and trades. Retreat is advancing with Fiera Real Estate.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.body: Plans change as markets do. Cliffside launched as condominiums in 2024 and is now being built as 209 rental homes.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: Through Elevate Construction Management, the team that plans a project is the team that builds it.

featured.heading: Purpose-built rentals, shaped by their neighbourhoods.

map.heading: Five of our eight communities are on Kingston Road.
map.body: From Merge Condos at Danforth Avenue to Everston near U of T Scarborough, Kingston Road is where our work is most concentrated, close to the Bluffs, the ravines and GO transit. Our projects also reach Leslieville and Riverdale, and we continue to look for opportunities across the GTA.

leasingBand.heading: Everston: 566 rental homes by the Campus Valley.
leasingBand.body: Floor plans, pricing, amenities and tours are on everston.ca.

elevate.heading: Development and construction, under one roof.
elevate.body: Elevate Construction Management is LCH’s affiliated construction manager. Working together from early planning through delivery helps us make informed decisions about design, cost, quality and schedule, and how each community will serve its residents.
